note: Configuration registry (E03). Field meanings and the consistency rules: runtime/orgene/configs.py. Gene records keep naming only the scopes C3, C3L, C3E; configurations point at a scope through gene_scope. max_rounds 2 is the main setting for every repairing configuration; the 1-round point is derived from the same run. token_cap is set in 1D (dev P90 of the matched configuration).
